name: 13_adieux_laplage
scene: Il s'éloigne au bord de l'eau. Les vagues effacent ses traces presque aussitôt.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE full-screen cinematic visual novel CG, landscape 16:9, requested 1920 x 1080 pixels, opaque image.
Primary request: A beautiful, deeply emotional FINAL FAREWELL SHOT for Monsieur Laplage. He walks slowly away along the waterline of an alien shore at the sunset of two suns. This is his last goodbye after giving his powers and his creeper keychain to his successor Theo. He knows his life is coming to an end. Show only Laplage and the landscape, a quiet moving goodbye filled with affection, exhaustion, acceptance, and a little hope.
Input images: Image 1 is the character IDENTITY and beige coat / black turtleneck reference ONLY. Image 2 is the LOCATION and two-sun alien coast continuity reference ONLY. Image 3 is the illustrated anime CG STYLE and quality reference ONLY; do NOT include its two characters or its destruction.
Subject: a recognizably elderly man with swept-back silver-white hair, white moustache and a little chin stubble, the exact face of reference 1. Beige mid-thigh trench coat, black ribbed turtleneck, dark trousers, dark shoes. He has ALREADY GIVEN AWAY THE GREEN CREEPER KEYCHAIN: do not depict any green charm or keychain on him. No glasses. No other people, no Theo, no foreground observer.
Composition: lyrical medium-wide cinematic shot from behind and a little to the side; Laplage is a substantial solitary full-body figure around the left-of-center third, about 45 percent of frame height, walking away along a gently curving shoreline toward the right horizon. His head turns only slightly in a final tender three-quarter profile so his white moustache, tired eye and faint bittersweet smile remain readable; his body and stride unmistakably move away. Coat hem and silver hair gently lifted by the sea breeze, relaxed lowered arms, one hand near his coat pocket. No salute or thumbs-up. A trail of solitary footprints leads from the foreground toward him, with a shallow wave softly erasing the nearest prints: a quiet visual metaphor for farewell. Immense luminous sea and sky surround him and give the image breathing room. Keep his head and emotional gesture in upper two-thirds, lower quarter mostly wet reflective sand and sea for the future dialogue box, but do NOT draw any dialogue box.
Landscape continuity: preserve the rocky alien coast, subtle pink-purple coastal plants and distant rebuilt retro-futurist human settlement along the far LEFT shoreline from reference 2, but viewed from a new angle following the waterline, with the city only a faint distant part of the landscape and NO readable signs or lettering. Two suns close to setting over the ocean: the orange-red sun mostly below the horizon, the smaller pale golden sun touching the water, their paired reflections crossing the ripples and wet sand. Soft lavender clouds, muted mauve blue shadows, luminous peach and warm amber rim light outlining the beige coat, far islands dissolving into sunset haze. A tranquil, beautiful world he saved but is now leaving.
Style/medium: match the existing CG reference 3 with refined expressive anime character drawing, precise fine linework, richly painted detailed environment, natural proportions, delicate atmospheric perspective and cinematic light. Fully integrate Laplage into this newly painted landscape with believable contact shadow and reflection; no pasted sprite appearance. Painterly anime, not photorealism or 3D. The emotion is restrained and sincere, heartbreaking yet peaceful. The dying light and disappearing footprints carry the farewell. Laplage remains corporeal, no literal disintegration, no ghosts, no magic beam, no visual gag.
Constraints: exactly ONE character, ONE complete full-bleed illustration, no panels, no border, no text, no speech, no subtitles, no watermark, no UI, no star-shaped planet, no spacecraft or TARDIS, no tragedy spectacle, no oversized crying face.
export: Bicubic resize, no crop. Original preserved.
